svg.title: Subject-grouped model selection, development refitting and independent testing
svg.desc: Six schematic development subjects, each with grouped images, enter three folds. Fold one fits subjects S3 through S6 and holds out S1 and S2. Each setting and fold fits its own selected normalization, optional PCA or KRONOS graph parameters, and RF or SVM. Held-out subjects use those fitted parameters. Image confusion counts are combined within each subject. The subject matrices are divided by their own observation totals before combination and macro-F1 calculation. The largest candidate score selects settings that are fitted anew on all six development subjects. The resulting saved model is applied to separate test subjects S7 and S8 for independent testing. Subject identities, image shapes, class-count symbols and the illustrated allocation are schematic; no measured accuracy or default cohort size is shown.
svg.text: Fit and apply each setting within a fold
Give each held-out subject equal weight
